scene.en: Li phones a hairdresser to book a haircut.
scene.zh: Li 打电话给理发店预约剪发。

lines: On the phone you say “det är” + your name.
打电话时用“det är” + 名字介绍自己。
Hej, jag skulle vilja boka en tid för klippning.
Hi, I'd like to book an appointment for a haircut.
“Jag skulle vilja …” = I would like to … – the polite version of “jag vill”.
“Jag skulle vilja …” = 我想……，是“jag vill”的礼貌版。
Certainly. When would you like to come?
Har ni något på torsdag eftermiddag?
Do you have anything on Thursday afternoon?
Torsdag klockan tre är ledigt. Passar det?
Thursday at three is free. Does that work?
Li Wang. Shall I spell it?
Yes please. And your phone number?
好的，谢谢。你的电话号码？
Noll sju noll, ett två tre, fyra fem, sex sju.
Zero seven zero, one two three, four five, six seven.
Swedish phone numbers are read digit by digit in groups: 070-123 45 67.
瑞典电话号码按组逐个数字读：070-123 45 67。
Tack. Då ses vi på torsdag!
